verdict.rationale: Rive's AI Agent/MCP tools are explicitly documented to handle repetitive, large-scale creation tasks — 'State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more' — and components/instances propagate changes across many instances at once, which supports bulk-style operations. However there's no evidence of a general-purpose bulk API (e.g., batch edit/query across arbitrary asset sets) beyond these editor-AI-agent use cases. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch API or CLI command operating across many arbitrary items (not just AI-agent-generated structures), and independent confirmation of this at scale.
